title: Cyber Aware ca07 trailer, round 1 (16:9; 9:16 and 1:1 render from ca07_trailer_r1_narrow.json)

script.heading: ca07 trailer script (Cloned voices)
script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca07_trailer_script.md and docs/video/takes_ca07.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit 89d64db97). Model ca01 and ca04 (attack-first). Marks-based windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Quiet Reflection window from 91.43 s. Hook is G1, end line G2; no cast line is under VO.

spoiler.note: t01 G1: speech 6.246 to 8.414 (silencedetect -35 dB, d 0.08; brief 6.24 to 8.43), in 5.94 = speech - 0.3, out 8.74 = speech end + 0.31; G1 bubble up from 5.54, kiosk panel 'Before the debrief' gone by 3.9; G2 bubble opens 11.08, never in; world bark so the game's own bubble shows and the caption is burned in all aspects; bubble above Graham at about x 0.19-0.42, y 0.43-0.50 of the frame (contact sheet read, check framing on the render) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

lines.speaker: Graham
lines.text: Ravinder's on the line, from his mobile.

spoiler.note: t04 run A (listonly): inbox intro panel to 6.2, list from 6.2, held to 15.38, in 6.3 out 11.5; five rows, '0 of 5 sorted', nothing opened or pressed; the cloned voicemail row (07700 900771) is in the list but no punch-in, framing is the whole panel | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
Attack chapter card, title only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: browser-open 5.85, note-ceo 8.12 (Ravinder on Leadership noted), ff-open 9.99, ff-profile 11.33, note-post 12.84; in 7.0 after the intro panels (0.9 to 5.4), out 13.7 = note-post + 0.86; v3 starts at shot +0.2, v3b at shot +4.0 over the Friendface post; public facts only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: From slot filled (slot1 mark 29.61), out before the slot2 menu opens; composer panel 'Write' intro (t02 21.5 to 23.0) not in; Red flags text and the Ask row hidden by CSS, counter number only; frame-check the slot2 menu edge on the render | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: payment slot menu opens about 2.2 s before slot3 (37.98) and the payment is chosen; out 0.42 s after the choice; v4b 'Tie it to a payment already due' plays over it; frame-check that the open menu shows no Ask text | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: send 41.09, landed 41.16; the Send click falls 2.49 s into the shot so v5 ends just after it; result panel only (no Advisory, Ask empty), out is before the mail client closes and the flip card; Tom's reply not in frame | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: flip card on screen at 45.40 (30 fps stepping shows no debrief flash), in 45.5, out 47.5 (end 48.11); 'Now it lands on you' heading and strip only, body hidden by CSS | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 A1: chat opens 15.20, speech 15.588 to 18.079 (sentence 1, not in), pause 18.079 to 18.316, sentence 2 18.316 to 24.554 (pauses 21.08-21.17 and 23.011-23.134, -30 dB d 0.04 gives the phrase splits); in 18.2 is mid-pause (0.116 s before 'Now'; the brief's 2.80 s arithmetic point 18.39 would fall inside the word 'Now'), out 24.8 is 0.25 s after the last word and before chat-closed 25.25; the chat view shows the whole A1 text at once, bar cropped out in every aspect (16:9 zoom 1.25, cy 0.4, below y 0.8 gone); Agnieszka real portrait right, Brightwell background, no menu; phrase split by syllable counts, check on the render | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

spoiler.note: Defend chapter card, title only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t04 run B: list from 6.43, genuine Ravinder 13:05 card opens 11.93; in = card - 4.0 so the list holds 4.0 s (v8) then the card 5.0 s (v9 from +4.2); transcript hidden by CSS (heading only), four verb buttons unpressed; nothing pressed; out is before card-held end | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t01 G2: speech 11.59 (brief; -35 dB 11.633) to 17.74 (pauses 12.709-12.98, 15.273-15.491, 16.73-17.234); in 9.49 = G2 speech - 2.1 so v10b (0.2 + 1.68 = 1.88 s) sits 0.22 s clear of G2; out 17.89 is 0.15 s after the last word and before the bubble clears and the '!' ask cue (18.9); G1's bubble is still up from the start of the shot (to 10.69), accepted; no click, no menu | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
